notes: «وَ سَأَلَهُ أَبُو بَصِيرٍ» : the asker is a link; the Imam who answers is only the pronoun «سأله», so he is taken from prev2, the nearest report that writes its chain («عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ»)
prev1 opens with a question and writes no chain, so it is passed over
needs_ruling: «وقال أبي رحمه الله في رسالته إلي» is a second saying with its own isnad (the author's father's letter), which the rules do not settle
